judgment_calls: Ferrule shipped as solid hex prism (20 tris) instead of hollow ring (48 tris) to stay under 24-tri preference.
Parts lie along +Y on a flat face; pivot bottom centre, x/y centred, z-min 0.
FBX has material slots only; BaseColor PNGs shipped separately in tex/.

assets.name: prop-marking-knife-blade-mk1
assets.desc: Flat steel marking-knife blade blank, 12x97x2.5 mm, rectangular stock ending in a single spear tip whose top face bevels down to a thin edge at the point (single-bevel, not dovetail-shaped). 5-sided prism, 16 tris.

assets.name: prop-marking-knife-handle-mk1
assets.desc: Wooden octagonal handle blank, 100 mm long, ~20 mm across flats, lying on a flat face along Y; plain capped ends. 28 tris.

assets.name: prop-marking-knife-ferrule-mk1
assets.desc: Short brass ferrule ring blank, solid hexagonal prism 14 mm long, 25 mm across corners, lying on a flat face along Y (solid, no bore). 20 tris.

assets.name: prop-striking-knife-blank-mk1
assets.desc: Thicker steel striking-knife blank, 20x115x6 mm, heavier rectangular stock ending in a double-bevel point converging to mid-thickness. 14 tris.
